source.description: Anonymous human preference votes on multi-turn conversations. Fixed editorial rating anchors approximately 1428.8889–1600 place Grok 4.6's September 5 recorded rating of 1446 at 10 points. Bounds do not move with new results; ratings are not percentages. Agent Arena is a related collaboration fallback, not the same preference experiment.

Overall causal net improvement across five signals from real user sessions. Stored in percentage points relative to the comparison baseline, not task success percent. Fixed editorial -5 to +25 percentage-point anchors map linearly to 0–100 points; zero improvement maps to 16.67 points. Includes Praise vs Complaint, so weighting that separately introduces intentional overlap.

Separately weightable causal treatment effect for tasks where explicit praise outnumbers complaints. This is improvement relative to a baseline, not the percentage of users who praise a model. Fixed editorial -5 to +35 percentage-point anchors map linearly to 0–100 points; zero improvement maps to 12.5 points.

Full-task binary/strict completion on the authors' August 2026 full task release. Desktop and browser workflows with computer tools, including image input. Preserve harness differences in observations; never mix partial rewards, offline-only results, or June task files into this metric.
Verified real desktop and browser task success. Run-specific step limits, tools and evaluated task denominators remain in provenance. A shorter-workflow fallback for OSWorld 2.0.

source.citation: Roboflow Vision Evals, September 5, 2026 high-tier snapshot
source.description: Reasoning from images through spatial relationships, comparisons, arithmetic and multi-step inference. Uses ground-truth accuracy graded by Gemini 3.5 Flash, not the strict-match score. High-tier settings may differ from catalogued max/xhigh efforts; those observations are marked as supporting evidence.
AA Terminus 2 evaluation of Terminal-Bench 2.1. Older, easier tasks than v4; converted to the v4 scale only through a frozen calibration.
AA 10-option visual academic reasoning evaluation. Related to Baby Vision but more knowledge-dependent; native image input is required.
Verified semi-private static grid reasoning. This older suite does not measure all of ARC-AGI-3's interactive exploration abilities.
Strict task completion on held-out business workflows: every final-state assertion must pass. Uses Zapier leaderboard runs, not AA objective-completion scores.

source.citation: ServiceNow EnterpriseOps-Gym; independent Artificial Analysis evaluation (2026)
source.description: Strict final-state success across eight enterprise domains, using AA Stirrup in oracle tool mode with three repeats. Relevant tools are supplied; this is not a tool-discovery evaluation.
70 scientific research workflow tasks, with executable evaluation and three trials per task. Official leaderboard observations retain each model’s agent and reasoning effort.

source.benchmarkName: Artificial Analysis Long Context Reasoning v1.1
source.description: 100 human-written questions requiring reasoning across document sets of 10k–100k tokens. Independent AA evaluation reports pass@1 accuracy averaged over three runs.

91 private agentic knowledge-work tasks across four business scenarios, evaluated with Stirrup. Combined Elo incorporates rubric correctness, analytical quality, and presentation. Index normalization uses fixed editorial anchors of 500 to 2000 Elo, not a benchmark percentage or official upper bound.
66 difficult terminal tasks evaluated in isolated Harbor environments, using the official versioned dataset and leaderboard accuracy.
Deep software engineering benchmark requiring multi-file architectural refactoring, complex bug reproduction, and multi-package patch synthesis in sandboxed repositories.
Whole-repository architectural comprehension, deep call-graph tracing, system design rationale, and cross-file dependency QA.

source.citation: Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus v3 (Chollet & ARC Prize Foundation, 2025-2026)
source.description: Interaction with unfamiliar environments, scored by level completion and action efficiency relative to humans.

source.citation: Center for AI Safety / Scale AI; independent scores by Artificial Analysis (2025-2026)
source.description: Ultra-challenging multidisciplinary academic questions designed to test frontier knowledge at the limits of domain expertise.
Fine-grained spatial grounding, visual object occlusion, physical 3D relationship tracking, and complex diagram parsing.
Knowledge reliability index ranging from -100 to 100; correct answers are rewarded, hallucinations are penalized, and refusals are not penalized.

source.citation: Sierra Research τ-Bench / τ-Knowledge; independent scores by Artificial Analysis (2026)
source.description: 97 multi-turn banking customer-service tasks over a large knowledge base, evaluated through policy-following, knowledge retrieval, and state-changing tool-use success.

source.citation: SciCode Benchmark; independent scores by Artificial Analysis (2024-2026)
source.description: Scientist-curated scientific research coding problems requiring domain knowledge, reasoning, code synthesis, and executable validation across the natural sciences.
Proportion of correctly answered questions out of all questions, regardless of whether the model chooses to answer.
Proportion of incorrect answers among non-correct responses when the model should have refused or admitted it did not know the answer.

source.citation: CritPt Benchmark; independent scores by Artificial Analysis (2025-2026)
source.description: Research-level physics reasoning benchmark built from unpublished challenges across modern physics domains and evaluated with challenge-level accuracy.
Median generation speed in tokens per second under standard API evaluation workloads.

source.benchmarkName: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index Task Time
source.description: Weighted average decode time in seconds per Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index task, excluding time to first token and overhead.
Seconds from API request submission until the first answer token is received; for reasoning models this includes thinking time.

source.citation: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index Task Pricing (2026)
source.description: Weighted average monetary cost in USD required to execute one Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index task.

70% cache-hit input, 20% uncached input and 10% output per million total tokens. Uses a coherent provider endpoint and pricing tier; cache creation and storage charges are outside this token-price blend.
